	To whom it may concern. This is the Maclisp system area: it
contains files which are loaded into Maclisp at runtime. No files
with an extension of FAS should ever be deleted. At times this
area will contain files such as MACLSP.RLn; These are REL files
produced at MIT and are for consing up Maclisps and are not
as critical as the FAS files.
